_about: Curated fixes for published third-party text, applied when a tool shows it (study_bible_mcp/published_text.py). 'corrections' never edit the publisher's wording: each inserts a '[⚠ Correction: note]' right after 'match' (exact text as displayed) in the Aquifer item named by resource_type and content_id (or title). 'transcriptions' fix transcription/OCR slips that are not the edition's wording, in one ancient-source passage field, at display and at import.

corrections.title: Abraham
corrections.match: left Haran at the age of 74.
corrections.note: Genesis 12:4 gives Abram's age on leaving Haran as 75 (as the article's own '25 years' of waiting, to Isaac's birth at 100, implies).

corrections.title: high priest
corrections.match: The high priest killed a lamb, and took the blood inside the temple.
corrections.note: Leviticus 16 prescribes no lamb on the Day of Atonement: the high priest killed a bull as the sin offering for himself and his household (16:6, 11) and a goat for the people (16:9, 15), and took the blood of each into the Most Holy Place (16:14–15; Heb 9:7, 12). 'The lamb' later in this paragraph has the same slip.

transcriptions.reason: Latin Wikisource transcription slip (h read as b); the Clementine Vulgate prints 'cum his qui cum eo sunt' ('with those who are with him'), and 'cum bis' is not Latin.
